purpose: Free 조직의 20 동시 job 한도에서 merge queue가 지속 운영되도록, 검증의 완전성과 판정 권위를 유지한 채 PR 단계의 중복 실행만 제거한다.

authorityMap.mergeAuthority: GitHub repository ruleset 27097366 (and 27525972) — Axiom does not reimplement merge admission

agentAuthority.merge: human-gated: trust-surface changes bypass the auto-merge queue (ADR-0041 §2.6); audited MUST-T2 break-glass lane

rulesetState.verification: PUT then readback; diff of before-vs-readback was exactly one hunk (the max_entries_to_build value). required 7 contexts, enforcement=active, bypass_actors=[], target=branch, ref_name.include=[~DEFAULT_BRANCH] all unchanged.
rulesetState.rollback: PUT the before-JSON with max_entries_to_build=2; the same readback procedure verifies the restoration.
rulesetState.secondRulesetObserved: 27525972 (main-admission) requires admission-check:5795152 alone, active, bypass_actors=[]. Not modified by this slice.

before.note: Natural observations, not synthetic benchmarks. Executed job count = jobs with status=completed and conclusion!=skipped at the terminal attempt.

publicationMgRun.note: The landing venue already runs all 9. The venue split does not change this number.

expectedDelta.honestLimit: 25 > 20. A single PR push still exceeds the Free organization's concurrent-job limit after this slice. The venue split reduces saturation but does not remove it; the remaining dominant term is admission-gate's 13 executed PR jobs.

J1_semanticParity.method: The pre-change evaluator (git show HEAD:tools/ci/publication_report.nim) and the post-change evaluator were run on identical landing-venue inputs. Projection fields {gate, verdict, verdictSemantics, dimensions, blockers, unresolvedUnknowns, unresolvedUnknownCount, binding} were field-value identical; .binding (including policyRevisions sha256) identical. Only additive fields differ.
J1_semanticParity.note: 'identical' means normalized JSON field values, not raw bytes; key order and serialization are not part of the claim.

J2_evidenceEquivalence.method: Same run as J1; the dimension reports consumed and the binding hashes are unchanged. The landing venue consumes the same five dimension reports as before.

J3_cacheSoundness.method: The J3 harness targets the cache owner (manifest inside the B-layer payload, restore-side digest loop). --judgment cache-manifest against this workflow returns FAIL(rc=2) because the workflow declares no actions/cache or restore-keys usage (0 hits). Recorded as out-of-domain rather than forced green.

J4_workerDeterminism.method: The J4 harness requires AXIOM_PROVE_WORKERS usage. This workflow contains 0 occurrences, and running the harness on an empty directory reports '0 runs, >=5 required' FAIL(rc=2). Recorded as out-of-domain rather than forced green.

invariantsHeld.aggregatorNeverSkipped: if: !cancelled() on every venue; SL-21 PRODUCER_SKIPPABLE accepts exactly always() or !cancelled()

after.note: Same counting rule as before: executed job = status=completed and conclusion!=skipped at the terminal attempt, queried per PR-event workflow run at the PR head.

prPush.observedDelta: publication-integrity 9 -> 2 executed jobs; every other workflow unchanged; total 32 -> 25.

publicationPrRun.observation: The preflight venue ran exactly the enumerated required dimension (secret-scan) plus the never-skipped aggregator, and the landing-only dimensions were skipped rather than reported green.

landingAcceptanceOnCanonicalMain.purpose: Prove the landing venue still runs all five dimensions on the landed canonical main SHA after the split.
landingAcceptanceOnCanonicalMain.result: PASS — the landing venue executed all five dimensions (9 jobs) on the landed canonical main SHA and the aggregator reported success. The venue split removed zero landing coverage; it only removed PR-venue duplication.
landingAcceptanceOnCanonicalMain.semantics: workflow_dispatch is a landing-venue event by the closed enum, so this proves the landing branch of the venue selector against real main content, not a PR merge commit.

mergePath.lane: audited MUST-T2 break-glass: trust-surface PR, so the Admission App refused its own verdict (trust_surface=FAIL mismatch:.github/workflows/publication-integrity.yml) and the PR could not enter the auto-merge queue.

liveDefectFoundAndFixedByThisSlice.signal: run 44857335107 job 136702863663 — this PR's own preflight reported 'PREFLIGHT UNKNOWN — gating drift: report supplied for license-scan'
liveDefectFoundAndFixedByThisSlice.cause: The workflow passes all five --report paths as one static argument list on every venue, so 'argument present' carried no information about whether the dimension ran. The evaluator read presence as drift.
liveDefectFoundAndFixedByThisSlice.fix: Drift signal is now the REPORT FILE EXISTING (a skipped dimension uploads no artifact). Pinned in both directions by tests: case 4 (produced file -> UNKNOWN) and case 5 (same arguments, never-produced paths -> PASS).

limits: The PR-venue job-count metric is auxiliary: the canonical cohort in ci_critical_path_metric.md §1 is merge_group x admission-gate, which this change does not touch.
A single PR push remains above the 20-job limit (25 vs 20) after this slice. The remaining dominant term is admission-gate's 13 executed PR jobs, produced under the external Admission App's contract.
peak<=16 is still a hypothesis, not an outcome. Verifying it requires a natural burst of >=3 concurrent PR pushes; the canonical wall/runner percentiles require n>=20 merge_group samples.
No SLO is claimed from n<20, and no claim is made that a single required-verifier outage cannot block merges.
24h without a defect is operational evidence, not a structural impossibility proof.

The landed merge used the audited break-glass lane because the change is a trust-surface change; the bypass window existed for 10 seconds and was restored with a readback in the same script invocation.
